status: exploratory follow-up; earlier test outcomes already observed
hypothesis: Final temporal-state readout preserves waveform phase better than averaging hidden states.
architecture_change: Replace mean hidden-state pooling by the last valid hidden-state position. All other architecture and optimization parameters remain as in cohort-v1.
training: Reuse only training-fit transforms, identical training people/clips, three seeds, 30 epochs, 128 steps, batch 128; no EEG reprocessing or new encoder calls.

selection.rule: For each arm independently, select maximum equal-clip mean signed channel correlation among weights whose development MSE does not exceed acoustic_ridge. Prefer smaller weight on ties. Report all weights. A selected zero is explicitly baseline-only, not a fusion success.

evaluation: Freeze development selection and predictions before rereading old test targets; exploratory only, never an untouched test. Same rows, channel masks, scales and metrics as cohort-v1. Include individual listeners, both clips and matched-versus-wrong-content control.
promotion_gate: Nonzero fusion weight; positive group correlation on both clips; group MSE below mean and acoustic_ridge; aggregate correlation above acoustic_ridge; matched-content MSE lower than wrong content on both clips. Passing remains exploratory and requires independent replication.
